method: Exact source-label to witness-label comparison of every imported verse. Consonantal comparison ignores points/punctuation and distinguishes word segmentation. Only marked rish+seyame and final semkath are normalized; ambiguous U+0716 and superscript U+0711 are retained and flagged. No witness text is imported into app data. Reference-only evidence uses response and per-verse hashes; raw pages are cached only in scratch storage.
limitations: Witness describes its OT as Syriac Orthodox Patriarchate2020; equality does not identify the supplied XML edition or establish redistribution rights.
Consonantal equality does not establish vocalization equality, word meaning, complete translation accuracy, or boundaries against STEP Standard/KJV.
This audits the guarded imported corpus; all raw-source damaged/excluded/sparse entries are separately enumerated in source-inventory.json.

witnessMergedRanges.policy: One witnessed text unit, not silently split or relabeled
